contract.notes: Registration refusal rows for the mandatory transactional refresh-family capability. The framework-owned front channel may be declared only when the route refresh broker implements CreateFamily, RotateFamily, ListFamily, and RevokeFamily in addition to the five store SPIs. A base-store-only bundle, a bundle with only the old optional ListFamily/RevokeFamily pair, and any bundle missing one transactional method are refused before any route is mounted and before a root or successor can be minted. Each runtime constructs the named variant from its own reference store and applies its real registration path; a refusal must name the missing capability or method, and a complete bundle must register. The old optional family pair remains exported for incident tooling but is not sufficient for the front channel.
